notes: PROPOSED by the mlk-market-closure-2027-01-18 initial research (2026-09-06) at D+0 -- it opens ON the closure, the tightest possible adjacency. Why it earns a row rather than being noise: Davos week 2027 is a week in which the loudest scheduled US policy voice is silent and the loudest unscheduled global one is not. The FOMC communications blackout runs 2027-01-16 -> 2027-01-28 (fomc-blackout-start-2027-01-16, estimate), so every Fed official is barred from comment across all five Davos days, and the January FOMC decision (fomc-2027-01-27, estimate) lands the session after Davos closes. Meanwhile the US equity tape is SHUT for Davos day 1 (2027-01-18, MLK) and does not reopen until Tuesday 2027-01-19, so the opening day's headlines price into no US session at all and arrive at Tuesday's open as a batch. THE HONEST LIMIT AND THE REASON IMPACT IS LOW: Davos is an agenda, not a print -- it has no consensus number, no scheduled release time and no surprise to measure, so nothing here is sizeable and no house playbook keys on it (trade-playbooks.md and multi-symbol-sweep.md were grepped this session for holiday|closure and returned zero hits; neither mentions Davos either). Its research value is an ATTRIBUTION TRAP, stated so a later session cannot fall into it: a gap on Tuesday 2027-01-19 has a three-day-weekend explanation, a post-expiration unpin explanation (opex-2027-01-15 is the preceding session), a Davos-headline explanation and a Fed-silence explanation before it has any single one. Filed estimate on a NEWS: prefix because weforum.org 403'd; the date itself is a scheduled recurring meeting, not a forecast.
